source: async function submit(tab,meta){const C=eval(load("ghCoreSource"));await tools.mcp__t3_code__preview_open({tabId:tab,open:true});const a=await C.W.ev(tab,"({url:location.href,text:document.body.innerText,fields:[...document.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=file]),textarea')].filter(x=>!x.name.includes('recaptcha')).map(x=>({id:x.id,value:x.value,checked:x.checked}))})");await C.W.H.saveJSON("job-search/applications/"+meta.id+"/answers.json",a);await C.W.ev(tab,"(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.innerText==='Submit application');if(!b)throw Error('Submit missing');b.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});b.click();return true})()");return meta.id;} async function receipt(tab,meta){const C=eval(load("ghCoreSource"));const r=await C.W.ev(tab,"({url:location.href,text:document.body.innerText})");if(/thank you for applying|application has been received|application was submitted|application has been submitted|successfully submitted/i.test(r.text)){await C.W.record(meta,r);return {confirmed:meta.id}}return r;}({submit,receipt})
